  "reason": "The intended fact states 'Neurons generate and transmit electrical messages as their primary mode of signaling' to reach targets like glands. The available relation 'reach_and_regulate' is defined as 'SOURCE entities propagate to TARGET entities to influence their functional activity'. This matches the core action of neurons sending signals (propagating) to glands to affect them (influence/regulate). Other relations like 'conducts' imply propagation along a specific structure (axon) which, while true biologically, narrows the scope compared to the general 'generate and transmit' assertion. 'regulates' misses the transmission/propagation aspect. 'reach_and_regulate' captures both the movement of the signal and its functional impact on the target without adding unnecessary structural details",

}
